title: Server: Message/set create in a room Chat should be a forbidden SetError (clean-room C17)
description: Clean-room C17: mimid returns method-level invalidArguments ('server-created Messages cannot be created...') for a Message/set create in a Chat with a roomId. Mark 2026-11-21: the draft will say forbidden SetError whatever the bodyType; invalidProperties (bodyType application/mimi-fanout) only for Chats without a roomId. Make mimid match.
